titleEn: The Glory of Kings — The False Witnesses (ch. 76, part 1 of 2)
part: ch. 76, part 1 of 2 — The False Witnesses
about: Binyas, a Benjamite mule-driver of King Manasseh, is egged on by Karmin's jealous neighbours to slander Karmin before the king. He brings two false witnesses from Armathaim, who rehearse a common story on the road and repeat it to the king's satisfaction. The king orders Karmin's household put to the sword; the witnesses, meanwhile, feast with Karmin, until an angel wakes him to flee.

sentences.t: ፸፮ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ሰማዕተ ፡ ሐሰት ።
sentences.l: 76. Concerning witness-of falsehood
sentences.i: Chapter 76: Concerning False Witness
sentences.n: Chapter heading. በእንተ 'concerning' takes the construct state: ሰማዕተ 'witness-of' (construct singular of ሰማዕት, the plural would be ሰማዕታት; in church usage the same word means 'martyr', but here 'witness'), followed by ሐሰት 'falsehood'.

sentences.t: ወሀሎ ፡ ፩ ፡ ፀዋግ ፡ እምዘርአ ፡ ብንያም ፡ ዘስሙ ፡ ብንያስ ፡ ዘይስሕብ ፡ በቅለ ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወይሴስዮ ፡ ከርሚን ፡ ምስለ ፡ በቅለ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ምናሴ ።
sentences.l: And-there-was one ፀዋግ (wretch?) from-seed-of Benjamin, whose-name Binyas, who he-draws mule-of king-of Israel, and-he-gives-drink-him Karmin with mule-of king Manasseh.
sentences.i: There was a certain base fellow (?) of the seed of Benjamin, named Binyas, who drew the mule of the king of Israel; and Karmin gave him drink (?), together with the mule of King Manasseh.
sentences.n: ወሀሎ 'and there was' (ወ- 'and' + ሀሎ 'he/it was'); ፩ is the numeral 'one', used like 'a certain'. ፀዋግ is uncertain (?): the glossary has 'wretched, base', and the context (he draws the king's mule) may suggest a servant or attendant (?); Dillmann not available. እም- 'from', ዘርአ 'seed-of' (construct), ዘ- 'who/whose' (ዘስሙ 'whose name'). 'King of Israel' and 'King Manasseh' are the same king — Bezold's text names Manasseh, the 'king' of the earlier chapters. በቅለ is read as 'mule' (?). ይሴስዮ ከርሚን: 'he gives to drink' (3ms imperfect, causative of the root s-t-y 'drink') + -o 'him, it'; who gives drink to whom is unclear (?). I take Karmin as the giver and Binyas as the one given drink along with the king's mule; the other reading, Binyas watering the mule at Karmin's, is possible (?). The Karmin story continues from earlier parts.

sentences.t: ወእምጎሩ ፡ ለከርሚን ፡ ሀለዉ ፡ እለ ፡ ይቀንኡ ፡ ላዕሌሁ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ሣዕር ፡ ወዐዘቅት ፡ ወበእንተ ፡ ብዝኀ ፡ እንስሳ ፡ ወአግብርት ፤
sentences.l: And-from-his-neighbour, to-Karmin, were those-who they-envy against-him concerning pasture and-well and-concerning abundance-of livestock and-servants;
sentences.i: And among Karmin's neighbours there were some who were jealous of him, over his pasture and his well and the abundance of his livestock and servants;
sentences.n: እም- 'from, among', ጎሩ 'his neighbour'; the ለ- on ለከርሚን marks the possessor ('to Karmin' = 'Karmin's'). ሀለዉ 'there were' (plural), እለ 'those who', ይቀንኡ 'they are jealous' (imperfect 3pl of ቀንአ; ላዕሌሁ 'against/over him'). በእንተ 'concerning, because of'. ብዝኀ 'abundance-of' is a construct; ወ- joins nouns throughout ('and pasture and well').

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ምድር ፡ ርስተ ፡ አበዊሆሙ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ወበእንተ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ይፈቅዲ ፡ ያርሕቅዎ ፡ እምሀገሮሙ ።
sentences.l: for that land inheritance-of their-fathers it-is; and-concerning this they-wish they-remove-him from-their-town.
sentences.i: for that land was the inheritance of their fathers; and for this reason they wanted to drive him far from their town.
sentences.n: እስመ 'for, because'; ርስተ 'inheritance-of' (construct) አበዊሆሙ 'their fathers'. ይፈቅዲ is printed so (expected plural ይፈቅዱ) — as printed; read 'they want'. ያርሕቅዎ is subjunctive: 'that they remove him far' (caus. of ርሕቀ 'be far') + object -o 'him'.

sentences.t: ወይዋሕይዎ ፡ በእኪት ፡ ለብንያስ ፡ ሰሓቤ ፡ በቅለ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ወሐመይዎ ፡ ወይቤልዎ ፡ ይፀርፍ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ከርሚን ፡ ፀረፈ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ መሲሑ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይብል ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ኢኮነ ፡ ወልደ ፡ አግዓዚት ፡ አላ ፡ ወልደ ፡ አመት ፡ አረጋዊት ፡ እንተ ፡ ተሣየጥዋ ፡ በክልኤ ፡ መስፈርተ ፡ ቆሮስ ፡ ለግብረ ፡ ማኅረጽ ፡ ወግንፋል ፤
sentences.l: And-they-ply-him with-evil, to-Binyas, driver-of mule-of king, and-they-slander-him and-they-said-to-him: 'He-blasphemes this Karmin; he-blasphemed against king-of Israel, his-anointed of-God, saying: This king is-not son-of free-woman but son-of slave-woman aged, whom they-bought-her for-two measures-of kor for-work-of ማኅረጽ and-ግንፋል;
sentences.i: And they plied Binyas, the driver of the king's mule, with evil (?), and slandered him (?), and they said to him, 'This Karmin blasphemes! He has blasphemed against the king of Israel, the Lord's anointed, saying, "This king is not the son of a free woman but the son of an old slave woman, whom they bought for two measures of kor for the work of ማኅረጽ and ግንፋል;"
sentences.n: A long accusation; the quoted speech runs on through the semicolon. ወይዋሕይዎ ('they urge/work on him'?) and ወሐመይዎ ('and they slandered him'?) are uncertain (?) — I take both as the slanderers' approach; Dillmann not available; the (?) applies to the exact sense of both verbs. ሰሓቤ 'driver-of' (agent noun, construct; compare ይስሕብ in the first sentence). መሲሑ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'his anointed, of God', the suffix -hu anticipating the owner (the king as the Lord's anointed, as Saul and David are called in Samuel). ወልደ አግዓዚት 'son of a free woman' (አግዓዚ 'free'), against ወልደ አመት 'son of a slave woman' (አመት), አረጋዊት 'aged' (fem.). ተሣየጥዋ 'they bought her' (ተሣየጠ 'buy' + object -wa). ቆሮስ is the kor, a large dry measure (Hebrew kor). ማኅረጽ and ግንፋል are obscure (?) — I take them as terms for menial work, such as grinding or sifting (?); the slander is that the king's mother was a bought household slave. ኢኮነ 'is/was not'. በክልኤ: በ- 'for' (the price) + the numeral 'two'; ለግብረ ማኅረጽ: ለ- 'for' + 'work-of' (construct).

sentences.t: ወአንተ ፡ ተዋቀሦ ፡ በኀበ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ወዝልፎ ፡ እስመ ፡ ንከውነከ ፡ ስምዐ ፡ በቅድመ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ወኢናኀፍረከ ።
sentences.l: And-you, accuse-him before king and-rebuke-him, for we-will-be-for-you witness before king and-not we-will-shame-you.'
sentences.i: And you, accuse him before the king and rebuke him, for we will be your witnesses before the king and we will not put you to shame.'
sentences.n: ተዋቀሦ and ዝልፎ are imperatives with object suffix -o 'him' ('accuse him', 'rebuke him'). ንከውነከ ስምዐ 'we will be to-you a witness' — ን- is the 1st-person plural prefix, -ka 'to you'; ስምዐ is accusative, 'as witness'. ኢናኀፍረከ 'we will not shame you' (ኀፈረ 'be ashamed' in its causative sense). በቅድመ 'before'. ስምዐ 'witness' (accusative) is from the same root as ሰማዕተ in the chapter title, which is the agent noun.

sentences.t: ወአቀሙ ፡ ኪዳነ ፡ ወመሐሉ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይኩኑ ፡ ስምዐ ፡ ላዕሌሁ ፡ ለከርሚን ፡ በሐሰት ፡ ዘኢተናገረ ፡ በልሳኑ ፡ ወውስተ ፡ ኅሊናሁኒ ፡ ጥቀ ፡ ኢዐርገ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ነገር ፨
sentences.l: And-they-established covenant and-they-swore to-him that they-be witness against-him, against-Karmin, in-falsehood, who not-spoke with-his-tongue and-within his-thought-also not-at-all had-risen that matter.
sentences.i: And they made a covenant and swore to him that they would be witnesses against Karmin, falsely — he who had never spoken it with his tongue, and that matter had never at all entered his mind.
sentences.n: አቀሙ ኪዳነ 'they established a covenant' (አቀመ 'cause to stand, set up'); ከመ ይኩኑ 'that they be' (subjunctive). ዘኢተናገረ በልሳኑ — 'who did not speak with his tongue': ተናገረ is active here (a tä-stem, as in the glossed ተናገርዎ 'they spoke to him'), and ዘ- 'who' picks up Karmin, the accused, whose tongue and thought are clear of it. ኅሊናሁኒ: -ኒ is 'also, even'. ኢዐርገ 'did not go up' (ዐርገ 'ascend') — 'come up into the mind'. ጥቀ 'greatly', here with the negative 'not at all'. The unit ends with ፨, a stronger break than ።.

sentences.t: ወሖረ ፡ ብንያስ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዚኡ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ወነገሮ ፡ ዘንተ ፡ ኵሎ ።
sentences.l: And-went Binyas to his-lord the-king and-he-told-him this all.
sentences.i: And Binyas went to his lord the king and told him all this.
sentences.n: ኀበ 'to, toward'; እግዚኡ 'his lord' (እግዚእ 'lord, master' + the suffix -u 'his'; the compound name of God is a different word). ነገሮ 'he told him' (ነገረ + -o). Note ዘንተ 'this' (accusative of ዝ), ኵሎ 'all'.

sentences.t: ወይቤሎ ፡ ቦኑ ፡ ዘሰምዐ ፡ ምስሌከ ።
sentences.l: And-he-said-to-him: Is-there who heard with-you?
sentences.i: And he said to him, 'Is there anyone who heard it with you?'
sentences.n: ቦኑ 'is there?' (ቦ 'there is' + the question particle -ኑ). ዘሰምዐ 'who heard' (ዘ- 'who' + perfect). ምስሌከ 'with you' (ምስለ 'with' + -ka). The speaker is the king.

sentences.t: ወአውሥአ ፡ ወይቤ ፡ እወ ፡ ሀለዉ ፡ እለ ፡ ሰምዑ ፡ ፪ ፡ ዐበይተ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ዘእምአርማቴም ።
sentences.l: And-he-answered and-said: Yes, there-were those-who they-heard, two great-ones-of Israel, who-from-Armathaim.
sentences.i: And he answered and said, 'Yes, there were some who heard it: two notables of Israel, from Armathaim.'
sentences.n: አውሥአ ወይቤ 'he answered and said' (a stock formula; አውሥአ is a causative stem). እወ 'yes'. ሰምዑ 'they heard' (3pl). ፪ is the numeral 'two'. ዐበይተ 'great ones of' (construct plural of ዐቢይ). ዘእምአርማቴም 'who are from Armathaim' — ዘ- + እም- 'from' + the place; Armathaim is the Ramathaim of Samuel's birth (1 Samuel 1:1), the town named at the end of the previous part.

sentences.t: ወይቤ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ሖርኬ ፡ አምጽኦሙ ፡ በኅቡእ ፡ ከመ ፡ ንጠይቆሙ ፡ ለእመ ፡ የኀብሩ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ቃልከ ፡ ወንምትሮ ፡ ርእሶ ፡ ወሖረ ፡ ወአምጽኦሙ ፡ ለዘርዮስ ፡ ወካርሜሎስ ፡ ነገደ ፡ ምነሴ ፡ እስመ ፡ ምስሌሆሙ ፡ ተካየደ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢያኅፍርዎ ፡ በቅድመ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ስምዐ ፡ ሐሰቶሙ ።
sentences.l: And-said king: Go-then, bring-them in-secret, that we-examine-them whether they-agree with your-word, and-we-cut his-head. And-he-went and-brought-them, Zeryos and-Karmelos, tribe-of Manasseh, for with-them he-had-agreed that not they-shame-him before king concerning witness-of their-falsehood.
sentences.i: And the king said, 'Go, then, and bring them secretly, so that we may examine them to see whether they agree with your word, and cut off his head.' And he went and brought them — Zeryos and Karmelos, of the tribe of Manasseh — for he had come to terms with them (?) that they would not shame him before the king over the witness of their falsehood.
sentences.n: ሖርኬ 'go, then' (imperative of ሖረ + the emphasizing -ኬ). አምጽኦሙ 'bring them' (imperative, caus. of መጽአ 'come'). ከመ ንጠይቆሙ 'that we examine them' (subjunctive 1pl, ጠየቀ 'examine, inquire into'); ለእመ 'if, whether'; የኀብሩ 'they agree' (ኀብረ, the same verb as in chapter 1). ንምትሮ ርእሶ 'that we cut off his head' (subjunctive 1pl, coordinated with the preceding 'that we examine them') (ምትረ 'cut off'). The names ዘርዮስ Zeryos and ካርሜሎስ Karmelos are in Geʿez form, not otherwise identified; ለ- before them marks the object. ነገደ 'tribe-of' (construct); ምነሴ is Manasseh as a tribe, spelled differently from ምናሴ the king. ተካየደ 'he made an agreement' (?) (subject Binyas; the sense is from context, and the glossary flags it as uncertain); ኢያኅፍርዎ 'that they not shame him' echoes the promise in the earlier sentence.

sentences.t: ወበባሕቲቶሙ ፡ መከሩ ፡ በፍኖት ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይብሉ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ነገርናሁ ፡ ለንጉሥ ፡ ለእመ ፡ ተጠየቀነ ፡ በበ ፡ ባሕቲትነ ፡ ከመ ፡ ያእምር ፡ ጽድቀ ፡ ቃልነ ፡ ወይብለነ ፡ በአይቴ ፡ ሰማዕክሙ ፡ ዘንተ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ንበሎ ፡ በባሕቲትነ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ንሰቲ ፡ ወይነ ፡ ምስሌሁ ፤
sentences.l: And-by-themselves they-took-counsel on-the-road, saying: When we-have-told-him, the-king, if he-questions-us each by-our-solitude, so-that he-may-know truth-of our-word, and-he-says-to-us: Where did-you-hear this word? let-us-say-to-him: In-our-solitude, while we-drink wine with-him;
sentences.i: And by themselves, on the road, they took counsel together, saying, 'When we have told the king, if he questions us one by one, so that he may know the truth of our word, and he says to us, "Where did you hear this word?", let us say to him, "In private, while we were drinking wine with him";
sentences.n: Their rehearsed cover story begins here and runs through the next three units; each inner question is introduced by ወሶበ 'and when'. በባሕቲቶሙ 'by themselves' (ባሕቲት 'alone' + -omu 'their'); መከሩ 'they took counsel' (መከረ). ሶበ ነገርናሁ 'when we have told it' (1pl perfect + -hu). ተጠየቀነ 'he questions us' (tä-stem + -na 'us'; active, as ተስእሎሙ 'he questioned them' in a later sentence; a 1cp passive would be ተጠየቅነ) (?). በበ ባሕቲትነ 'each by himself, one by one' (repeated በ-). ጽድቀ 'truth-of' (construct). ንበሎ 'let us say to him' (subjunctive 1pl of ብህለ). እንዘ ንሰቲ 'while we drink' (እንዘ + imperfect = 'while'). ወይነ 'wine'. In ምስሌሁ 'with him', the 'him' is Karmin, the man they accuse; the king is 'him' in ንበሎ.

sentences.t: ወሶበ ፡ ይቤለነ ፡ ምንት ፡ ዕለቱ ፡ ንበሎ ፡ አመ ፡ ሠረቀ ፡ ወርኅ ፡ እንተ ፡ ኀለፈት ፡ ኀሙስ ፤
sentences.l: And-when he-says-to-us: What its-day? let-us-say-to-him: On-the-day it-rose month which it-passed, Thursday;
sentences.i: and when he says to us, "What day was it?", let us say to him, "On the day the new moon of the month just past appeared — a Thursday";
sentences.n: ምንት ዕለቱ 'what is its day?'. አመ 'on the day when' (አመ + perfect). ሠረቀ 'it rose', said of the sun or moon; ወርኅ is both 'month' and 'moon'. The phrase 'the new moon of the month just past' for አመ ሠረቀ ወርኅ እንተ ኀለፈት is my reading (?) — it could be 'when last month began'. ኀሙስ 'Thursday', literally 'fifth'. The relative and its verb are feminine, so 'month' takes feminine agreement here.

sentences.t: ወሶበ ፡ ይቤለነ ፡ አየ ፡ ጊዜ ፡ ንበሎ ፡ በ፱ ፡ ሰዐት ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይነብር ፡ ማእከሌነ ፡ ወንሰቲ ፡ ወይነ ፡ ኅቡረ ፤
sentences.l: And-when he-says-to-us: Which time? let-us-say-to-him: At-ninth hour, while he-sits in-our-midst and-we-drink wine together;
sentences.i: and when he says to us, "At what time?", let us say to him, "At the ninth hour, while he sat among us and we drank wine together";
sentences.n: አየ ጊዜ 'which time?'. በ፱ ሰዐት: ፱ is the numeral 'nine', so 'at the ninth hour' (ሰዐት 'hour'); numerals are words and read as such. እንዘ ይነብር 'while he sits' — the sitter is Karmin, whom they claim to have drunk with. ማእከሌነ 'in our midst, between us'. ኅቡረ 'together'.

sentences.t: ወሶበ ፡ ተስእለነ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይብል ፡ በምንት ፡ ሰተይክምዎ ፡ ወአይቴ ፡ ነበርክሙ ፡ ንበሎ ፡ በቀናዲል ፡ ዘወርቅ ፡ ወምንባሪነሂ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ጽርሕ ፡ ኅቡረ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምፅንጋ ፡ ዕ ።
sentences.l: And-when he-questions-us, he-saying: With-what drank-you-it and-where were-you? let-us-say-to-him: By-lamps of-gold, and-our-sitting-also within hall together, within ምፅንጋ, ዕ.
sentences.i: And when he asks us, saying, "With what did you drink it, and where were you?", let us say to him, "By golden lamps (?), and our seating was in a hall, together, in a ምፅንጋ (?), ዕ..."
sentences.n: ተስእለነ 'he asks us' (tä-stem, active, + the object -na; compare ተስእሎሙ 'he questioned them' below, and ተጠየቀነ above, the same type) (?). ሰተይክምዎ 'you (pl.) drank it'. ቀናዲል is the plural of ቀንዲል 'lamp' (?) — 'by golden lamps' is a strange answer to 'with what did you drink', so the sense is uncertain (?); Dillmann not available. ምንባሪነ 'our seat, our sitting' (a noun from the root of 'sit, dwell' + -na 'our', near መንበር 'seat'; the exact formation is uncertain) (?); -ሂ 'also'. ጽርሕ 'hall, chamber', the word used of the sanctuary in chapter 1. ምፅንጋ is unknown to me (?). The ዕ at the end of the quoted speech is as printed: a single letter, probably a fragment of a word or a damaged reading; I have not tried to complete it. The unit ends with ።, closing the rehearsal.

sentences.t: ወበዛቲ ፡ እኪት ፡ ምክር ፡ ኀብሩ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ፍኖት ።
sentences.l: And-in-this evil counsel they-united within road.
sentences.i: And on the road they agreed together on this wicked plan.
sentences.n: ዛቲ እኪት ምክር 'this evil counsel' — ምክር 'counsel, plan' takes feminine agreement here. ኀብሩ 'they united, agreed', the same verb as in chapter 1 and in ይኀብሩ 'agree' above, here with sinister sense. በውስተ 'within, in the midst of'; ፍኖት 'road'.

sentences.t: ወሶበ ፡ በጽሑ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ አብጽሖሙ ፡ ብንያስ ፡ ወሐተቶሙ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ወነገርዎ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ምክረ ፡ ሐሰቶሙ ፡ ወተስእሎሙ ፡ በከመ ፡ መከሩ ፡ በፍኖት ፡ ጊዜሁ ፡ ወዕለቶ ፡ ወሰዐቶ ፡ ወመስቴሆሙ ፡ ወመናብርቲሆሙ ፡ ወነገርዎ ።
sentences.l: And-when they-arrived to king, brought-them Binyas, and-examined-them king, and-they-told-him all counsel-of their-falsehood, and-he-questioned-them according-as they-planned on-road: its-time and-its-day and-its-hour and-their-drink and-their-seats, and-they-told-him.
sentences.i: And when they reached the king, Binyas brought them in, and the king examined them. They told him the whole plan of their falsehood; and he questioned them just as they had planned on the road — the time, the day, the hour, their drinking, and where they sat — and they told him.
sentences.n: በጽሑ 'they arrived'; አብጽሖሙ 'he caused them to arrive, brought them' (causative + -omu). ሐተተ 'examine, investigate'. ነገርዎ 'they told him'. ምክረ 'counsel-of' (construct; compare ምክር above). ተስእሎሙ 'he questioned them' (a ተ- stem with -omu). በከመ 'according as'. መስቴሆሙ 'their drink', መናብርቲሆሙ 'their seats' (plural of መንበር). Everything is just as rehearsed in the preceding sentences.

sentences.t: በከመ ፡ አዘዘ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ይጠይቁ ፡ ፍትሐ ፡ ነገሥት ፡ ወመኳንንት ፡ ወኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ በልዑል ፡ መንበር ፡ በከመ ፡ አዘዞ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ።
sentences.l: According-as commanded God: they-examine judgment, kings and-princes and-all those-who they-sit on-high seat, according-as commanded-him God to-Moses.
sentences.i: As God commanded, kings and princes and all who sit on a high seat are to examine the judgment — as God commanded Moses.
sentences.n: The law of Moses on the examination of witnesses: Deuteronomy 19:15-19 (the judges shall make diligent inquiry; a false witness suffers what he planned for the accused) and Deuteronomy 17:6 (a charge stands on two or three witnesses). ይጠይቁ 'they examine' (jussive 3pl of ጠየቀ, the verb above). ፍትሐ 'judgment' is in the accusative, and ነገሥት ወመኳንንት 'kings and princes' are the subjects; the same ፍትሐ ነገሥት could be read as 'law of kings' (the name of a later Ethiopian law code), but then the verb has no subject (?). እለ ይነብሩ 'those who sit'. አዘዘ 'he commanded' / አዘዞ 'he commanded him'; ለ- before ሙሴ 'to Moses'.

sentences.t: ወዘንተ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ተጠየቀ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ጸውዖ ፡ ለሊቀ ፡ ሐራሁ ፡ ዘይቀውም ፡ ቅድሜሁ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ ሖር ፡ ነግሀ ፡ በጽባሕ ፡ ወዕግታ ፡ ለቤተ ፡ ካርሚን ፡ ወኢያምሥጥከ ፡ ፩ ፡ እምእሊአሁ ፡ ኢተባዕት ፡ ወኢአንስት ፤
sentences.l: And-this, when he-examined, the-king, he-summoned the-chief-of his-host, who he-stands before-him, and-said-to-him: Go, at-dawn in-morning, and-surround the-house-of Karmin, and-not let-escape-you one from-his, neither male nor female;
sentences.i: And when the king had examined this, he summoned the commander of his army, who stood before him, and said to him, 'Go at dawn in the morning and surround the house of Karmin, and do not let one of his people escape you, neither male nor female;
sentences.n: ጸውዖ 'he summoned him' (ጸውዐ 'call'; ለሊቀ marks the object). ሊቀ 'chief-of' (construct), ሐራ 'host, army' (+ -hu 'his'). ዘይቀውም ቅድሜሁ 'who stands before him' (ዘ- + imperfect). ወዕግታ 'and surround it' — imperative of ዐገተ with -a 'it' (the sense 'surround, shut in' is my reading (?)). ኢያምሥጥከ 'let him not escape you' (negative jussive, አምሠጠ 'escape' + -ka 'you'). ፩ is the numeral 'one'; እምእሊአሁ 'from those of his, of his own'. ተባዕት 'male' / አንስት 'females' (plural form). ወዘንተ ሶበ ተጠየቀ: ተጠየቀ is the tä-stem 'inquire into', active in sense (as ተስእሎሙ 'he questioned them' above), with ወዘንተ as its fronted accusative object and ንጉሥ as subject: 'when the king had inquired into this' (?). A passive reading would leave the king without a role.

sentences.t: ቅትል ፡ በአፈ ፡ ኀጺን ፤
sentences.l: kill with-mouth-of iron;
sentences.i: kill them with the edge of the sword;
sentences.n: Command continues: ቅትል 'kill!' (imperative of ቀተለ). በአፈ ኀጺን 'with the mouth of iron', the stock idiom for 'with the edge of the sword' (ኀጺን 'iron').

sentences.t: ወለሊሁኒ ፡ ምትር ፡ ርእሶ ፡ ወአምጽእ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ንዋዮ ፡ ወበርበሮ ፡ ወእንስሳሁ ፡ ወወርቆ ፡ ወብሩሮ ።
sentences.l: and-himself-also, cut his-head, and-bring all his-goods and-his-plunder and-his-livestock and-his-gold and-his-silver.
sentences.i: and as for him himself, cut off his head, and bring all his goods, his plunder (?), his livestock, his gold, and his silver.'
sentences.n: ወለሊሁኒ 'and as for him himself' (ለሊሁ 'himself' + -ኒ 'also'). ምትር 'cut off!' (imperative; compare ንምትሮ above). አምጽእ 'bring!'. The goods are listed with the suffix -o 'his' on each: ንዋዮ, ወርቆ (ወርቅ 'gold'), ብሩሮ (ብሩር 'silver'). ወበርበሮ is uncertain (?): it can be read as the noun 'and his plunder', but the form fits a verb 'and plunder him' (with the object -o) as well (?); the list of possessed goods around it favours the noun, which I keep. The king's speech ends here.

sentences.t: ወተፈሥሑ ፡ ወገብኡ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ሐሳውያን ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሀገሮሙ ፡ ወሖሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቤተ ፡ ካርሚን ፡ ወተናገርዎ ፡ በነገረ ፡ ሰላም ፡ ወይዌድስዎ ፡ ወይስሕቁ ፡ በቅድሜሁ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ልቦሙ ፡ እኪት ፤
sentences.l: And-they-rejoiced and-returned those liars to-their-town, and-went to house-of Karmin and-spoke-to-him with-word-of peace and-praised-him and-laughed before-him, while within their-heart evil;
sentences.i: And they rejoiced, those liars, and went back to their town, and went to the house of Karmin and spoke to him with words of peace and praised him and laughed in his presence, while in their hearts was evil;
sentences.n: ተፈሥሑ 'they rejoiced' (ተፈሥሐ). ገብኡ 'they returned'. ሐሳውያን 'liars' (plural, from ሐሳዊ 'false'). ተናገርዎ 'they spoke to him' (ተናገረ + -o). በነገረ ሰላም 'with word-of peace' (construct). ይዌድስዎ 'they praise him' (ወደሰ; the sense 'flatter' is implied). እንዘ + a noun clause: 'while in their heart evil' — ልቦሙ 'their heart' is singular in form (ልብ + -omu). The Psalm allusion that follows depends on this picture.

sentences.t: አሜሃኬ ፡ ተፈጸመ ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ ፡ ትንቢተ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ ዘይቤ ፡ እለ ፡ ይትናገሩ ፡ ሰላመ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ቢጾሙ ፡ ወእኩይ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ልቦሙ ፡ ሀቦሙ ፡ በከመ ፡ እከየ ፡ ምግባሮሙ ፡ ወበከመ ፡ እከየ ፡ ኅሊናሆሙ ።
sentences.l: Then-indeed was-fulfilled upon-them prophecy-of David, who-said: Those-who they-speak peace with their-neighbours and-evil within their-heart — give-them according-as evil-of their-deeds and-according-as evil-of their-thoughts.
sentences.i: Then was fulfilled upon them the prophecy of David, who said: 'Those who speak peace with their neighbours while evil is in their hearts — give them according to the evil of their deeds and according to the evil of their thoughts.'
sentences.n: The allusion is to Psalm 28:3-4 (LXX 27:3-4): 'who speak peace with their neighbours while evil is in their hearts', followed by the plea 'give them according to their deeds'. David is called a prophet, as in Acts 2:30. አሜሃኬ 'then indeed' (አሜሃ 'then' + -ኬ). ተፈጸመ 'was fulfilled' (passive of ፈጸመ). ትንቢተ 'prophecy-of' (construct). ዘይቤ 'who/which said' (relative + 3ms perfect of the defective verb). ቢጾሙ 'their neighbours' (ቢጽ 'fellow, neighbour'). ሀቦሙ 'give them' (imperative of ወሀበ). እከየ 'evil-of' (construct), ምግባሮሙ 'their deeds', ኅሊናሆሙ 'their thoughts'. The wording of the Geʿez, not its source text, is what I render.

sentences.t: ወእሙንቱሰ ፡ ሰክሩ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ቤተ ፡ ከርሚን ፡ ወኖሙ ፡ ኅቡረ ፡ ምስሌሁ ።
sentences.l: And-they, indeed, got-drunk within house-of Karmin and-slept together with-him.
sentences.i: And they, for their part, got drunk in the house of Karmin and slept together with him.
sentences.n: እሙንቱሰ 'as for them' (እሙንቱ 'they' + the contrastive -ሰ: 'they, for their part'). ሰክሩ 'they got drunk' (ሰክረ). ኖሙ 'they slept' (ኖመ). ከርሚን is spelled ካርሚን in the next sentence — the same man.

sentences.t: ወሶበ ፡ ኖሙ ፡ ናሁ ፡ ተፈነወ ፡ መልአከ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ኀበ ፡ ካርሚን ፡ ወአንቅሆ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ ኅድግ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ንዋየከ ፡ ወአድኅን ፡ ርእሰከ ፡ እስመ ፡ ተአዘዘ ፡ እምኀበ ፡ ምናሴ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይምትሩ ፡ ርእሰከ ፤
sentences.l: And-when they-slept, behold, was-sent angel-of God to Karmin and-awoke-him and-said-to-him: Leave all your-goods and-save your-head, for it-was-commanded from Manasseh king that they-cut your-head;
sentences.i: And when they slept, behold, an angel of the Lord was sent to Karmin and woke him and said to him, 'Leave all your goods and save yourself, for it has been commanded by King Manasseh that they cut off your head;
sentences.n: ናሁ 'behold'. ተፈነወ 'was sent' (passive of ፈነወ). መልአከ 'angel-of' (construct). አንቅሆ 'he woke him' (causative of ነቅሀ 'be awake', + -o). ኅድግ 'leave!' and አድኅን 'save!' are imperatives; ርእሰከ 'your head', here 'yourself'. ተአዘዘ 'it was commanded' (passive of አዘዘ); እምኀበ 'from (the side of)'. ከመ ይምትሩ ርእሰከ 'that they cut your head', as the king ordered above. The king is here named ምናሴ Manasseh (Bezold's text), the 'king' of earlier chapters.

sentences.t: ወንሣእ ፡ እምንዋይከ ፡ መጠነ ፡ ትክል ፡ ዘፈቀድከ ፡ ወጒይይ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ብሔረ ፡ ባዕድ ፡ እስመ ፡ ቀታሌ ፡ ነቢያት ፡ ወኀሣሤ ፡ ደመ ፡ ንጹሓን ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ምናሴ ።
sentences.l: and-take from-your-goods as-much-as you-can what you-wished, and-flee into land-of other, for killer-of prophets and-seeker-of blood-of innocents he, Manasseh.
sentences.i: and take of your goods as much as you can, whatever you have wished, and flee to a foreign land; for he is a killer of prophets and a seeker of the blood of the innocent (?) — Manasseh.'
sentences.n: ወንሣእ 'and take!' (imperative of ነሥአ); መጠነ 'as much as', ትክል 'you are able', ዘፈቀድከ 'which you wished'. ጒይይ 'flee!' (imperative). ብሔረ 'land-of' (construct) ባዕድ 'other, foreign'. ቀታሌ ነቢያት 'killer-of prophets' (agent noun in the construct); Manasseh's killing of the prophets is a later Jewish and Christian tradition (that he had Isaiah sawn in two), beside 2 Kings 21:16 ('he shed very much innocent blood'). ኀሣሤ ደመ ንጹሓን 'seeker-of the blood of the innocent' — I read ኀሣሤ ደም as one who hunts down or demands blood, hence 'seeker of the blood' (?). ውእቱ ምናሴ 'he (is) Manasseh', a closing clause with the predicate first.
